decisions.briefing: Markets slipped today, with the NASDAQ down 0.9% and the S&P 500 down 0.4%, so this was a mildly weak, neutral day with no clear direction. We have only $445.88 in cash, which is below the $500 minimum for a new buy, so we are holding all seven positions and keeping that cash for a stronger day. Several candidates (TOP, KLAR, FOUR, CGON, VKTX) score 100 on every signal, and they are first in line once cash and the market allow.

market_education.summary_en: US stocks drifted lower today, with tech-heavy NASDAQ names falling more than the broader S&P 500, which suggests investors were taking some risk off the table rather than selling in a panic. No news headlines were provided for today, so we cannot point to a specific cause, but a moderate drop like this, with tech leading, often reflects profit-taking or caution about high-valuation growth stocks. Big chip names such as NVDA, AMD and INTC are trading below their 20-day averages, which fits that picture of weaker semiconductors and AI-linked stocks.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日小幅回落，以科技股為主的納斯達克跌幅大於標普500，反映資金傾向減持風險資產，而非恐慌性拋售。由於今日未有相關新聞資料，難以確定具體觸發因素，但科技股領跌的溫和調整，通常源於獲利回吐或市場對高估值成長股的觀望情緒。NVDA、AMD及INTC等大型晶片股股價均跌穿20日均線，亦印證半導體及AI相關板塊走勢轉弱。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder is cash an investor keeps on hand so they can buy when a good opportunity comes along. We don't push leftover cash into a new stock on a flat or slightly negative day; we keep it ready for a clearly strong day, when the odds are better. Being patient with small amounts of cash helps you avoid weak, rushed trades.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」是指投資者預留的現金，以便在出現良好機會時隨時入市。在市況平淡或輕微下跌的日子，我們不會為了用盡剩餘資金而勉強買入，而是留待市場明確轉強、勝算較高時才出手。對小額閒置資金保持耐性，有助避免倉促作出質素欠佳的交易。
